description_en: Retrieves the list of trending topic hotspots
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi list-hot-news-with-type --agent-key c160c841c8e54295bf2f441432785944_p_efm --news-type society --news-types society --size 10 --current 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHotNewsWithType

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the business space: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027170.html
parameters.name: agent_key

parameters.help_en:
The news category. Valid values:
- society: social current affairs.
- person: people news.
- government: government affairs
parameters.help_zh: 新闻类别。society: 社会时事，person: 人物新闻，government: 党政时事
parameters.name: news_type

parameters.help_en:
The list of news categories for multi-selection. Valid values:
- society: social current affairs.
- person: people news.
- government: government affairs
parameters.help_zh: 新闻类别列表多选。society: 社会时事，person: 人物新闻，government: 党政时事
parameters.name: news_types

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page
parameters.name: size
